python3 << 'EOF'
# 1940 monthly national defense expenditures (in millions)
defense_1940 = [132, 129, 143, 159, 154, 153, 177, 200, 219, 287, 376, 473]

print(f"1940 Total: {total_1940}")

total_1953 = sum(defense_1953)
print(f"1953 Total: {total_1953}")

# Calculate absolute percent difference
# Formula: |1953 - 1940| / 1940 * 100
abs_diff = abs(total_1953 - total_1940)
percent_diff = (abs_diff / total_1940) * 100

print(f"\nAbsolute difference: {abs_diff}")
print(f"Absolute percent difference: {percent_diff:.2f}%")
